source_boundary.Bhāṣya: praṇidātā and praṇidhātā are given in discussing transformed ghu forms.
source_boundary.Kāśikā_pinned_field: prāṇidātā for the dāṇ item. Only this source reading has long ā in the outer preverb.
source_boundary.selection: The ordinary pra + ni construction has no operation lengthening the a of pra here. The written table uses praṇidātā following the Bhāṣya and retains the literal Kāśikā string as an edition-specific observation, outside the inflected grid.
source_boundary.persons: The inherited luṭ third-person endings neutralize the contrast of P and A.

rule_scope: Ghu is assigned on the lexical history; 6.1.45 supplies ā to the ec-final teachings in the relevant non-śit formations, and 6.4.67 distinguishes the active e from middle ā before the blessing.
